content_record.title: Intermittent fasting: metabolic switch to longevity
content_record.editorial_body: A new review confirms that time-restricted eating triggers conserved survival pathways, extending lifespan and improving health across species. Fasting activates AMPK and sirtuins, boosting autophagy and mitochondrial health. Gut microbiome shifts produce butyrate, reducing inflammation and organellar apoptosis. Ancestral feast-famine cycles explain why periodic energy deprivation enhances resilience. This signal is based on Health Benefits of Intermittent Fasting. from PubMed. Read the original report for full context.
